description: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook series (monthly, 18-month horizon): retail and wholesale electricity prices (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP), ERCOT load and generation by fuel, U.S. generation shares, Henry Hub. Rows with status 'projection' are EIA projections, not observed values. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

id.description: Optional STEO series ids, comma-separated (e.g. ELWHU_TX, ELLOAD_TX)

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

name: market_outlook
